source: Speed factors relative to the TrackMan PGA Tour averages: TrackMan's published amateur averages put a scratch golfer's driver near 105 mph, a 14-handicap near 94 mph and a 25-handicap near 85 mph (TrackMan 'Amateur averages', estimated from their charts). Dispersions (one standard deviation) are gameplay estimates chosen so that tour pros hit about 60-70 % of greens from 150 yards and higher handicaps progressively fewer.
